name: Mid-Season Invitational 2027
overview: The Mid-Season Invitational 2027 (MSI 2027) is a Tier 1 international League of Legends event held at the midpoint of the 2027 season. Organized by Riot Games, it takes place in Paris, France, from August 5 to August 15, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 1,000,000. The qualified teams and format have not been announced.
